description: This file contains a test fixture class `TestAppFactory` used for creating an in-memory test environment for the `DataAssetBackend` minimal API. It configures a web host with custom environment settings, database connection strings, and an authentication handler that allows for authenticated requests during testing.

classes.name: TestAppFactory
classes.description: A sealed class that extends `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` to customize the web host for testing. It overrides the `ConfigureWebHost` method to set environment variables, configure app settings, and implement a custom authentication scheme for testing purposes.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to customize the web host during testing. Sets environment to 'Testing', configures database connection strings, and installs a permissive authentication scheme that allows all requests to pass authentication checks with a test user.

methods.name: HandleAuthenticateAsync
methods.description: Implements the authentication handler to always succeed by providing a ClaimsPrincipal with predefined roles and user name, enabling authentication-dependent endpoints to be tested without real credentials.
